messages:
marie: Heads-up — we're seeing a tokenizer regression in eu-west1 causing intermittent 502s on short prompts. Root cause points to the tokenizer lib bump that landed in canary. Requesting an expedited out-of-window hotfix to pin the serving image and push a canary. Affected service: ml-serving (model redwood/fast-gen:v2.3.1 -> pin to v2.3.0). Logs: https://internal/err/1234 :exclamation:
jake: I see the alerts too. +1 to expedite if we can run a quick smoke e2e and start a small canary (3-5%). Paging @ops-oncall and @sanjay for a pin + rollout plan. :eyes:
laura: what's the rollback criteria? we need clear automatic thresholds before we touch prod.
sanjay: Proposed flow: kubectl set image deploy/ml-serving=redwood/fast-gen:v2.3.0 --record; start canary at 3%; monitor for 10m then step to 20% if stable. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 10m OR tokenization idempotency errors > 0.1%. I'll prepare a minimal canary manifest and enable verbose logs for the canary slice.
deploy-bot: [auto] Checklist: preflight checks: capacity OK, infra health OK, canary manifest: ready, tests: pending. Out-of-window override requested by marie. Required approvers: @eng-release, @eng-sre.
ops-oncall: +1 for out-of-window with strict canary caps. I'll be watching and can shift traffic off immediately. Recommend setting X-Canary header and enabling real-time tailing.
jake: +1 from platform side as long as preflight tests pass. Also recommend adding a 50-golden-prompt eval run against the canary.
laura: +1 if rollback thresholds are enforced and golden prompt eval runs are green. Will own post-deploy checks.
marie: Approving expedite. Sanjay, please execute the pin. I'll draft the short release note and prepare a status page update template in case we need to notify.
sanjay: Executing now:
```
kubectl set image deploy/ml-serving ml-serving=redwood/fast-gen:v2.3.0 --record
```
Starting canary at 3% in eu-west1.
deploy-bot: [auto] Deployment started. region=eu-west1, canary=3%. preflight-tests=PASS. monitors enabled: error-rate, latency, tokenization-idempotency. ETA stabilize ~5m.
ops-oncall: Tailing logs — 5xx at 0.02%, tokenization errors negligible, latency +2ms. Holding.
marie: If stable, plan to step to 20% in 10m. @sanjay confirm when 20% is up.
sanjay: Stepping to 20% now. No regressions observed during the step. Verbose logs enabled for canary traffic.
marie: Posting release note draft: 'hotfix: pin fast-gen to v2.3.0 to mitigate tokenizer regression causing 502s in EU region. Rolling canary now; full rollout contingent on 30m observation.'
deploy-bot: [auto] Rollout 20% complete. Observation window active for 30m. Rollback condition set: revert to redwood/fast-gen:v2.3.1 if any configured metric breaches.
laura: Noted — I'll run the 50-golden-prompt eval and report results in 15m. Adding a postmortem owner for follow-up (laura).
ops-oncall: 15m in: metrics stable, no breach. Ready to proceed per plan.
marie: Thanks all. If stable at 30m we'll finalize the rollout and update CHANGES.md + status page. I'll close the window and file the brief incident notes.
laura: filing a short postmortem ticket and test gap checklist.
sanjay: Full rollout initiated. Finalizing release note and tagging the deploy.
deploy-bot: [auto] Deployment complete: rollout=100% in eu-west1. Final status: PASS. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
